Gestures & Shortcuts

Mouse
Click empty (Bond tool)Place new atom
Drag from atom (Bond tool)Draw bond to new/existing atom
Click atom, no drag (Bond tool)Retype to the selected element
Click atom/bond (Select tool)Select atom · cycle bond order
Drag empty (Select tool, ⇧ adds)Marquee-select
Drag an atom (Select tool)Move that atom
Drag a selected atom (≥2 sel.)Move whole group — any tool
Click atom/bond (Erase tool)Delete it
Click atom (Charge), ⇧+click+1 charge · −1 charge
Double-click atomQuick element-retype palette
Scroll wheelPan
⌃/⌘ + scroll wheelZoom
Right-click (or ⌃/⌘+click)Delete atom/bond under cursor
Right-drag held (or ⌃/⌘+drag)↕ zoom · ↔ rotate sel./molecule
⇧+drag from empty canvasSpin whole molecule
Drag the ⟳ handle (≥2 sel.)Rotate selection (⇧ = 15° steps)
Middle-drag, or hold Space+dragPan
Trackpad
Two-finger swipePan
Pinch, or ⌃+two-finger swipeZoom
Tap / click / click-dragSame as the matching mouse gesture above
⌃+click, held + drag↕ zoom · ↔ rotate (right-click equivalent)
⇧+click-drag from empty canvasSpin whole molecule
Touchscreen
One finger: tap / dragDraw, select, or place — per active tool
Two fingers: dragPan
Two fingers: pinchZoom
Two fingers: twist (≥2 sel.)Rotate selection, together with pan/zoom
One finger on the ⟳ handleRotate selection
No touch equivalentRight-click/⌃-drag, ⇧-drag-to-spin
Keyboard
S / B / ESwitch tool — Select / Bond / Erase
1 / 2 / 3Bond order — single / double / triple
← / → (⇧ = 15°)Rotate selection 30° (or a placing template)
Delete / BackspaceRemove selected atom
⌘/Ctrl + ASelect all
⌘/Ctrl+Z · ⌘/Ctrl+⇧+Z (or +Y)Undo · redo
EscCancel current action / clear selection
Hold Space (+drag)Pan while held

The rotate handle only appears, and the ←/→ keys only rotate, when 2+ atoms are selected. Right-click/⌃-drag rotates that selection too when one exists, but falls back to the whole molecule when nothing is selected. ⇧+drag from empty canvas always spins the whole molecule, selection or not — except in the Select tool, where ⇧+drag-on-empty already means "add to the marquee selection" instead.
